from extracted import _line_ranges as operation

def apply(mask):
    if not isinstance(mask, list) or any(type(v) is not bool for v in mask):
        raise TypeError('The observed adapter accepts a list of booleans.')
    universe = list(range(1, len(mask) + 1))
    selected = [i + 1 for i, value in enumerate(mask) if value]
    return [[start - 1, end - 1 + 1]
            for start, end in operation(universe, selected)]
